candidates.published_measure: Project-stage, location, schedule and publisher-estimated capital cost records
candidates.exclusion_reason: Publisher stages and estimated costs do not disclose realized region-period spend or labour input, and reproducible historical revisions are unavailable.

candidates.published_measure: Issued permits with location, job description and reported construction value
candidates.exclusion_reason: Keyword classification is inferred and permits record authorized intent and reported value, not realized AI-construction activity.

candidates.published_measure: Annual provincial construction capital expenditure for broad industries and estimate vintages
candidates.exclusion_reason: NAICS 51 is broader than data centres, the geography is provincial and the frequency is annual.

candidates.published_measure: Monthly non-residential investment by province and selected metropolitan areas
candidates.exclusion_reason: The series aggregates building types and cannot isolate AI or data-centre construction.

candidates.published_measure: Monthly permit value by geography and building type
candidates.exclusion_reason: Aggregated permit values are leading indicators of intended construction and do not isolate realized data-centre work.

candidates.published_measure: Survey instrument collects data-centre type, floor area, critical IT load, design load and annual energy use
candidates.exclusion_reason: The public instrument proves data-centre variables are collected, but published results are annual aggregates and do not expose building-level construction activity.

candidates.published_measure: Regional commercial and institutional building floor area, energy use and intensity for 2024
candidates.exclusion_reason: The released tables aggregate operating building energy and do not publish data-centre-specific construction dose by region-quarter.

candidates.published_measure: Annual employment by industry and census metropolitan area
candidates.exclusion_reason: Broad annual industry employment cannot identify data-centre construction labour hours or treatment onset.

next_evidence_needed: A public or disclosure-authorized source that identifies AI or data-centre construction, records realized spend or labour hours, links the measure to a project or region, and supports quarterly vintages with revision provenance.
search_boundary: Publicly available Canadian federal, provincial, municipal, regulator, utility, audit and issuer disclosures; no confidential respondent microdata or inferred allocation of announced capex.
